name: claude-uds-bridge
description: Discover and message live Claude Code and Codex sessions through local UDS inboxes.

interface.shortDescription: Exchange messages with local Claude Code sessions.
interface.longDescription: Session lifecycle hooks make this task discoverable through Claude ListAgents. Peer messages steer its active turn or start a new turn when idle. MCP provides listing, sending and status.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my local agent sessions and this task's receive status.
